Jump to

On tiers: every LANCER NPC class is built at a chosen tier, so any contact here could in principle be fielded at T2 or T3. Fourteen of them say so in their own scanned rules text — a weapon that gains attacks at T2 and T3, a Reliable value written per tier, heat written as 2/3/4. Those exact lines are recorded under Printed tier scaling in each dossier, and the Scales T1-T3 filter narrows the index to them. A contact missing from that list is not one that cannot scale; it is one whose scan simply did not print the numbers.

Named individuals encountered in the field, as opposed to the hostile contacts indexed elsewhere. Each file carries a portrait, a full-body reference where one exists, and whether they take a mech into the field.

Pilot files for the Lancers themselves. Each carries a record, the mech they take into the field, and any NHP assisting them. Comments are left in-character by whoever is keeping the log.

What is an NHP?

NHPs are paracausal in nature, with an effectively infinite capacity for cognition and information storage, but can still only learn and adapt, at most, as quickly as they take in new experiences and stimuli - even when unshackled.

Most of humanity primarily uses NHPs in military, scientific and administrative sectors, or as co-pilots for aircraft, spacecraft and mechs. Most NHPs are owned, controlled and managed by the local government, with NHPs in the full ownership of private individuals being quite rare.

The most visible form NHPs take are as administrative entities for urban centers in the Galactic Core, where a single NHP can orchestrate the goings-on of an entire city. Citizens of these municipalities regularly interact with their municipal NHP as it runs the city's public transportation, service delivery, database retrieval and other menial computational tasks for millions of people at once.

Reading this index

Two things worth knowing before you use these entries: the pairs most easily mistaken for one another, and the conventions used in the stat blocks.

Witch and Witch 2 are both real

Not a duplicate entry. Their stat lines are identical down to every number, but Witch 2 carries a fifth system, Petrify, which chains Slowed into Immobilized into Stunned.

If a Witch reaches its third round without that chain, it is the base version.

Two units called Operator

Operator is the T1 build. Security Unit 'Operator' is the same chassis at T2 — better across every defence and skill, with four extra systems and a stronger death explosion.

Two units called Hornet

Gongsi and Stormrider both field one, and they scan identically — not one of the sixteen stats differs. The tell is behavioural: the Gongsi build fights at range with Hex Missiles, the Stormrider build teleports in and plants coreworms.

Structure, Stress and Armor filled in

COMP/CON only draws the Structure and Stress track once a template pushes it past 1, so most scans show nothing there. Every NPC has at least 1 of each, so that is what this index records rather than a blank. Likewise a scan with no armor plate means Armor 0.

Heat is the exception and stays blank where absent: biologicals have no heat track at all, which is a real difference, not a gap.
